about: Tunables of pc/tools/room_blender.py (Gitea #20): the bake (Blender, per texture, from the room's geometry) and the maps made from it. Lengths in the exported room's units: 1 = 512 game units.

bake.bake_samples_note: Cycles path samples per texel; the bevel and ambient occlusion nodes sample their own.

maps.note: wear and cavity are 0..1 (edges the geometry exposes, creases it shades); cavity is 1 - the occlusion

metal.about: OPTIONAL SEED, off by default (maps are painted in a painter: pc/tools/paint_roundtrip.py, pc/docs/Materials.md). Metal and roughness from the texture's own colours, per texel (iron: cool, low saturation, dark to mid; brass: warm and saturated), then shaped by the geometry's wear and cavity. A texture takes a metal map only when metal texels are a share of it between min_share and max_share (stone that is cool grey all over is not iron; a gate's bars in a stone wall are). hue in degrees, sat and lum 0..1; soft = how far outside a range the weight falls to 0. A material with "neutral" matches the greys (saturation under sat_max) of a texture that also has colour: colour_share of its texels at saturation colour_sat or more (iron bands over wood planks, studs on a door); a texture that is grey all over is stone.
